# Hebei Pinjin Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

> Hebei Pinjin Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (河北品锦机械制造有限公司) manufactures electric trailer concrete pumps, diesel trailer concrete pumps, mixer pumps, spraying machines, and replacement pipeline / S-valve wear parts in Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai, Hebei, China (postal code 055150).

These are not truck-mounted boom pumps or concrete mixing plants. Trailer pumps are not spraying machines. This catalog lists English and Chinese pages only.

## Site
- [Home](https://pinjinpump.com/en/): English homepage for Pinjin Machinery.
- [首页](https://pinjinpump.com/zh/): Chinese homepage.
- [Product catalog](https://pinjinpump.com/en/products/): All published equipment categories.
- [产品目录](https://pinjinpump.com/zh/products/): 中文产品目录.

## Product categories
- [Electric trailer concrete pumps](https://pinjinpump.com/en/products/electric-concrete-pumps/): Electric trailer and compact transfer pumps. Not spraying machines.
- [电动混凝土泵](https://pinjinpump.com/zh/products/electric-concrete-pumps/): Chinese category page.
- [Diesel trailer concrete pumps](https://pinjinpump.com/en/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/): Diesel trailer concrete pumps for sites without three-phase power.
- [柴油混凝土泵](https://pinjinpump.com/zh/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/): Chinese category page.
- [Mixer pumps](https://pinjinpump.com/en/products/mixer-pumps/): Mix and pump on one trailer. Not a concrete mixing plant.
- [搅拌泵](https://pinjinpump.com/zh/products/mixer-pumps/): Chinese category page.
- [Spraying machines](https://pinjinpump.com/en/products/spraying-machines/): Hydraulic/diesel concrete sprayers and plaster spraying machines.
- [喷涂机](https://pinjinpump.com/zh/products/spraying-machines/): Chinese category page.
- [Concrete pump spare parts](https://pinjinpump.com/en/products/concrete-pump-parts/): Pipeline, S-valve, and wear parts. Quote after size confirmation.
- [混凝土泵配件](https://pinjinpump.com/zh/products/concrete-pump-parts/): Chinese category page.

## Contact
- [Contact](https://pinjinpump.com/en/contact/): Request a quote by email or WhatsApp. Quotes follow published catalogue tables.
- [联系我们](https://pinjinpump.com/zh/contact/): 中文询价页.

Spare parts: quote after size confirmation; no published list price; not sold in small batches. Wear parts are Xingtai replacements, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Equipment ships from Xingtai. This site does not claim an overseas warehouse, exclusive distributor list, or global after-sales network.
